text: Best flat white in Indiranagar, hands down. The pink walls and soft jazz made my Sunday.
Meera remembers my order every morning. Cappuccino is perfect, never rushed.
Grabbed a cappuccino and croissant in under three minutes before my metro. Legends.
Fries reached piping hot, packed in a neat box. Rare for delivery honestly.
Paneer tikka sandwich was bang on, even the no onion request was followed. Great packaging too.
Kids loved the strawberry shake and the pasta was spicy just right. Staff were so patient with us.
Worked here for four hours, the cold brew is smooth and nobody hovered. Wifi solid, plugs everywhere.
Chai and chilli cheese toast under 400 rupees, hostel budget approved. Sit for hours, no one minds.
Wonderful filter coffee, felt like a proper Bengaluru morning. The avo toast was fresh and generous.
Always consistent. Flat white ready by the time I finish paying. Thank you team!
That strawberry cheesecake. Wow. Basque style and not too sweet, I want another slice already.
Matcha latte is actually legit and the staff gave us a bigger table when our group showed up.
Cinnamon roll still warm, latte did not spill. Delivered ten minutes before the ETA.
Weekend brunch was lovely. Waffle crisp outside, soft inside, and they sorted a high chair instantly.
Filter coffee at a fair price and always hot. This is my second home now.
Best chai near college, quick and cheap. Kulhad adds the vibe.
Rose latte was lovely, a bit on the sweet side. Wait was ok for a busy Saturday.
Solid espresso, slightly pricey for a takeaway but the beans are worth it.
Sandwich was good but only lukewarm when it arrived. Taste top notch though.
Hot chocolate delicious, lid was a little loose but nothing leaked. Will order again.
Nice place to work, a tad crowded after noon. Iced latte kept me going all afternoon.
Food was great but took twenty five minutes with hungry kids. Worth it in the end.
Friendly staff, tasty blueberry muffin. A little more than I expected to pay but fine.
Good as always though the morning queue was long today. Cashier apologised, appreciated.
Fries are crisp and the portion is big enough to share. Seats fill up fast after 5.
Cosy corner and tasty cheese toast. Music was a touch loud but I would come back.
Ordered for twelve people, order complete and labelled. One cup lid missing but they sent a replacement.
Croissant a bit less flaky than usual today but the team more than made up for it.
Cheesecake arrived intact and tasted amazing. Slightly small for the price, still happy.
Lovely atmosphere and the coffee arrived quickly. Would have liked more seating inside.
Avocado toast was decent but took almost half an hour to come. Nice staff, slow kitchen.
Latte was fine, queue was slow and it cost more than last month. Not sure I will switch from my usual.
Pasta arrived barely warm. Taste was alright but not worth the delivery price.
Good brew but every table was taken by 11 and the music got loud. Hard to concentrate.
Waffle was good, matcha not as strong as I hoped, and the bill felt steep for students.
Got the sandwich but they missed the extra cheese I paid for, and the bag was slightly squashed.
Food was tasty but nobody came to take our water order for ages. Decent otherwise.
Cappuccino is still good but prices have crept up. Hoping they stay fair.
Chai was nice, staff seemed rushed so no smile today. Average visit overall.
Hot chocolate was a bit thin for 230 rupees. Pleasant place but not a repeat order.
Fries came cold-ish because the kitchen was swamped. Very crowded, no free table for 15 minutes.
Rider waited outside for ages and my cheese toast went chewy. Kitchen needs to time orders better.
Waited 40 minutes for avocado toast and nobody told us why. Walked out hungry and annoyed.
Missed my train waiting for a cappuccino. Ten minutes in the rush is not acceptable for takeaway.
Fries were soggy and stone cold. Packaging trapped steam. Disappointing after the great reviews.
They forgot the latte entirely and the sandwich had onion even though I wrote no onion.
Staff ignored us and the bill was bigger than the menu showed. Waffle was lukewarm.
Latte price went up again at lunch time. Felt like surge pricing, not cool for students.
No free table, laptop folks everywhere and a dirty table left for ages. Iced latte was watery.
Flat white tasted burnt today and the barista looked flustered. Not what I expect from you.
Order for the team arrived 50 minutes late and two items were missing. Very embarrassing in front of clients.
An hour for pasta. Staff shrugged and said kitchen was busy. We left without eating.
Arrived two hours late, everything cold and hard. Refund requested. Never again.
Hot chocolate spilled all over the bag, wrong order inside. Utterly careless packing.
Queue of fifteen minutes and then charged extra for a basic espresso. Rude cashier too.
Expensive and bland. Croissant tasted stale and nobody apologised. Tourist trap vibes.
Shake was warm, tables were sticky and the waiter was rude when we asked for a replacement.
Waited forever, got someone else's order, and then the chai was cold. Terrible afternoon.
Pasta was ice cold and glued together. Rider said he waited at the shop for half an hour.
Hot waffle, perfect cappuccino, order exactly as described. Smooth delivery all around.
Iced latte slightly pricey but the staff let us sit through the rain, so thank you.
Cinnamon roll tasty, though I stood around for a long time while orders piled up.
Chai in the rain by the window, with soft music and warm smiles. Exactly what I needed.
